exclusions.post_cutoff_results: all excluded by using only frozen synthesis result_summary.json
exclusions.technical_invalid_attempts: not included as execution results; source cutoff excludes C4_L1_A0_seed1022

fig1_filters.alignment: A1 for all panels; L0/A0 also retained in fig1_camera_runs.csv

statistics.completion: per-run complete/offered images; graph annotations use the median run fraction
statistics.image_p99: computed per run among complete images only; no pooling across runs
statistics.group_summary: median and interquartile range across runs; IQR is not a confidence interval

fig2_filters.per_run_statistic: maximum of individual flow-level p99s within one execution; neither maximum latency nor pooled p99
fig2_filters.group_summary: median and interquartile range across runs; IQR is not a confidence interval

reservation_note: idleSlope values are configured per-egress/per-class CBS reservations, not measured utilization; totals and 75% headroom refer to an individual egress port only.
synchronization_note: Approval applies to available samples only; continuous-time synchronization conformance was not demonstrated.
